text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ......I was told to rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: Let's make sure you heal up properly.

Injuries come with the territory! You'll 
get used to this situation too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Right, of course. I know that's what I 
should do, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm so... bored. Telling me to just lie in 
bed all day.

I made sure King Halo got plenty of proper 
rest starting that day so she could resume 
training as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I don't wanna get used to this, you 
clod.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, deep down I understand. Once 
you mess up, you have no choice but to 
accept it."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I need to sort through these unfamiliar 
feelings and focus on healing first—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, jeez! So why then am I feeling so 
frustrated?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even wasting time feeling frustrated is a 
luxury I can't afford! Get it together, 
me!!

Though she claimed to accept it, she 
seemed hard-pressed to truly come to terms 
with it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, yes. This is a good opportunity 
as well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"This is just another wall that every 
first-class Umamusume runs into."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I will become even stronger after this 
experience. The unknown might be 
frightening, but once it is known, it is 
nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer. Let us overcome it all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —All for the sake of my victory.

No matter what painful situations King 
Halo encounters, she always tries to stand 
right back up.

Just as she said moments ago, she will 
surely overcome this injury, too.
